how_to_apply: Print the Application Format attached to the official notification PDF.
Fill out the application form completely and self-attest the document.

Place the application and documents inside an envelope.
Super scribe the envelope with ‘Application for the post of Regional Security Officer OR Assistant Supervisor (Security)’.

Send the application through Post, Speed Post, or Courier to: Chief Human Resources Officer, AI Engineering Services Limited, Personnel Department, 2nd Floor, CRA Building, Safdarjung Airport Complex, Aurobindo Marg, New Delhi – 110003, to reach on or before 17:00 hours on 03 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: AIESL Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment drive aims to fill 11 vacancies across various stations of AIESL on a Fixed Term Employment basis.

content_sections.heading: AIESL Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Female Height: Minimum 154.5 cms Male Height: Minimum 163 cms Relaxation of 2.5 cms for SC/ST candidates and those from North East states & hilly states (subject to domicile proof).

rows.qualification_required: Experienced Candidates with valid BCAS Basic AVSEC (13 Day’s new pattern) Certificate: Graduates in any discipline (minimum 3 years’ duration) from a Recognized University with ability to speak Hindi, English and conversant with local language. Must possess valid BCAS Basic AVSEC Certificate with minimum 03 month’s validity as on 01.12.2026. Must have 5 Years of Security Supervisory Experience.

Experienced Candidates: Graduates in any discipline (minimum 3 years’ duration) from a Recognized University, ability to speak Hindi, English and conversant with local language, valid BCAS Basic AVSEC (13 day’s new pattern) Certificate with minimum 03 month’s validity as on 01.12.2026, and must have 01 Year of Security Supervisory Experience. OR Graduate Fresher / Ex-Servicemen: Graduate in any discipline (minimum 3 years’ duration) from a recognized University with ability to speak Hindi, English and conversant with local language.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIESL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIESL Recruitment 2026 is an employment drive conducted by AI Engineering Services Limited to fill 11 vacancies for Regional Security Officer and Assistant Supervisor (Security) posts on a Fixed Term Employment basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIESL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies available, comprising 1 post for Regional Security Officer and 10 posts for Assistant Supervisor (Security).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIESL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of application is 03 November 2026 up to 17:00 hours.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for AIESL Assistant Supervisor?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates in any discipline (minimum 3 years duration) from a recognized university with the ability to speak Hindi, English, and conversant with the local language, along with a valid BCAS Basic AVSEC certificate or eligibility as a graduate fresher/ex-serviceman.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for AIESL Regional Security Officer?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for Experienced Regional Security Officer and 35 years for Assistant Supervisor as on 01.10.2026, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.
